propositions: A cancelled or timed-out job in the Gerrit Verified Gate casts Verified -1 with a message exactly 'CANCELLED: <url>' that carries no job name, duration, or reason, requiring manual inspection of the run to triage.
The gerrit-review-action self-builds its message and exposes no input for custom text, so detail cannot be delivered through that action alone.

Two distinct failure modes produce the identical uninformative 'CANCELLED: <url>' vote: timeout-minutes budget exceeded and version skew on stale patchsets, which require different author actions (neither vs rebase).

A new pure summarize_ci_failures.py maps GitHub job payloads plus annotations to per-job triage lines, distinguishing TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED with duration and html_url, returning empty string when all jobs succeed.

The triage detail must be posted as an additional comment-only Gerrit review via SSH 'gerrit review <change>,<ps> --message' with no --label, executed in a continue-on-error step after the vote is cast.
The SSH comment step must validate change and patchset against ^[1-9][0-9]*$, use port 29418 with key chmod 600 plus known_hosts, and clean up the key in an if:always step.
